corrections.text: Cancelled List and Missed List are history lists - they ignore whether a replacement appointment exists. Call List is the work list: with default parameters it leaves out the appointments that were replaced or taken off the call list.
corrections.evidence_quote: `Cancelled List` and `Missed List` are history; `Call List` is the work list

corrections.text: DATE RANGE (Start Date / End Date) is matched on the appointment date and defaults to today - the 11/21/2026 of our capture is the capture day, not a fixed default.
corrections.evidence_quote: `DATE RANGE` | Appointment date; defaults to today.

corrections.text: CANCELLATION REASON limits the cancelled appointments to the chosen cancellation reasons - the system reasons and the ones the office defined.

corrections.text: Cancelled From Automated Campaigns lists the appointments that the patient cancelled through an automated campaign message.
corrections.evidence_quote: Appointments cancelled by the patient through an automated campaign message

corrections.text: Off call list = call-list entries that a user took off the list by ticking Off List (an entry also leaves the call list when it is rescheduled or when a new appointment is made; a removed entry can be restored). corrections.evidence_quote: An entry leaves the list when rescheduled, when a new appointment is made, or when a user ticks `Off List`; it can be restored.

corrections.text: Length, the Status checkboxes Missed / Cancelled and Include Off Call List mirror the filters of the Scheduler's Call List screen - Select Duration (mins), Show Missed, Show Cancelled, Show Off Call List. corrections.evidence_quote: Mirror the Scheduler `Call List` screen filters `Select Duration (mins)`, `Show Missed`, `Show Cancelled`, `Show Off Call List`
